stories.title: Validate State Medical Board URLs via URL Guardian
stories.description: Integrate url_guardian to validate constructed state medical board lookup URLs to ensure links are reachable, safe, and correctly formatted before inclusion in disciplinary signal output.

stories.title: End-to-End Integration Test for Disciplinary Signal Flow
stories.description: Create integration tests validating full flow from NPI lookup through provider_detail_service to evaluate_care_facade, ensuring disciplinary signal presence indicators and URLs are correctly propagated to API responses.

stories.title: Standardize State Board Link Construction Logic
stories.description: Refactor and centralize logic for constructing state medical board lookup URLs to ensure consistent patterns across supported states (DE, MS, VA) and enable maintainability for future expansion.
